# opnsense_haproxy_server (Resource)

A HAProxy real server: one target host that backend pools send traffic to. Requires the `os-haproxy` plugin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_haproxy_server" "web" {
  name    = "web01"
  address = "192.0.2.20"
  port    = 80
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) FQDN or IP address of this server.
- `name` (String) Name to identify this server. Letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` only.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for this server. Defaults to `""`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this server. Defaults to `true`.
- `mode` (String) Server mode: `active`, `backup` (only used when all active servers are down) or `disabled`. Defaults to `active`.
- `port` (Number) Port of this server. `-1` leaves it empty, which makes HAProxy use the port the client connected to. Defaults to `-1`.
- `ssl` (Boolean) When enabled, HAProxy connects to this server over SSL/TLS. Defaults to `false`.
- `ssl_verify` (Boolean) When enabled, the server certificate is verified when `ssl` is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the server.
